content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) provides resources aimed at improving access to care and enhancing the quality of diabetes management. Organizations such as the National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases (NIDDK) play a pivotal role in offering evidence-based guidance to healthcare systems that seek to transform their diabetes care practices. By leveraging tools such as patient registries and electronic health records (EHRs), healthcare systems can systematically assess the quality of care being delivered, monitor patient outcomes over time, and implement structured quality improvement cycles to optimize clinical practices and patient results.
